newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina to create job subsidies, end all others.
newsitem.headline: Argentina to create job subsidies, end all others.

text.p: Argentina next year will implement subsidies to create jobs, but eliminate all other practices which lead to direct or indirect government subsidies, Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said.

"The only thing we will subsidize from now on will be labor and not capital. Not because we ideologically reject capital, but because the problem in Argentina today is the creation of many new jobs," Fernandez said in an interview Thursday in the newspaper La Nacion.
Fernandez said his aim was to boost employment by financing part of the salaries of new jobs.
"It will be very a very simple and straightforward way to directly promote new jobs, and especially to make sure they are legal," he said.
"If there is one area of production where subsidies can be applied and costs reduced, it is labor. That's the priority."
The jobless rate in Argentina recently fell to 16.1 percent from 17.3 percent, but it remains one of the highest in Latin America and is the main issue at stake in October midterm elections.
Fernandez also said the wages of civil servants would remain frozen.
